record.question: Under the Empowering Mizoram Sports (EMS) Programme, the first phase focuses on athletes in which age group?
record.explanation: The printed question and options on page 3 are clear. The Government of Mizoram’s January 2026 address states that EMS begins with grassroots coaching and talent identification in its first phase and trains athletes aged 8–15 years, matching the programme’s official description (https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s30a87257e5308197df43230edf4ad1dae/uploads/2026/01/202601271237743754.pdf, p. 16; https://ems.mizoram.gov.in/about/).
